# Issue templates

The templates GitHub offers when an issue is opened. Each carries `name` and `about` frontmatter; this README has
none, so the chooser does not list it.

- `reading.md`: propose or correct a reading
- `falsification.md`: show that a reading or a sign value fails a test
- `rival-hypothesis.md`: put another analysis beside the one on record
- `rights-concern.md`: report material that its licence or rightsholder does not allow here
